remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_USE_MATH_DEFINES -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0600 -DWINVER=0x0600)

include_directories(${VKD3D_INCLUDE_DIRS})

spec2def(d2d1.dll d2d1.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# d2d1.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/d2d1-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(d2d1_shims OBJECT bitmap_render_target.c bitmap.c brush.c command_list.c dc_render_target.c device.c effect.c factory.c geometry.c hwnd_render_target.c layer.c mesh.c state_block.c stroke.c wic_render_target.c)
target_link_libraries(d2d1_shims PRIVATE wine dxguid dx10guid uuid oldnames chkstk libd3d10_1 libd3dcompiler_47 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libadvapi32_vista libuser32 libucrtbase libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(d2d1_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
if(ARCH STREQUAL "i386")
    target_compile_options(d2d1_shims PRIVATE -fno-builtin-ceil -fno-builtin-sqrtf)
endif()
set_wine_module_fixme(d2d1_shims)
add_dependencies(d2d1_shims wineheaders d3d_idl_headers)
add_cargo_module(d2d1 d2d1-cargo d2d1.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS d2d1_shims psdk d3d_idl_headers uuid_sources)
